title: arxiv_2602.13772v1
universal_lens: A polyhedral framework for offline 3D multi-object tracking unifies temporal context integration and global optimization through structured trajectory refinement. Offline-Poly unifies multi-object tracking via polyhedral trajectory optimization, integrating tracklet-level filtering, hierarchical matching, and multi-perspective refinement into a coherent geometric kinematic framework.
gsi_mapping: Bayesian inference maps offline tracking outputs to probabilistic object identities using temporal coherence and scene-level similarity priors. GSI employs Bayesian belief updates over trajectory likelihoods, where tracklet pre-processing acts as a conformal prior, and fusion/refinement stages refine posterior distributions through evidence aggregation.
gse_mapping: Situational reasoning models utilize full-sequence observability to infer object motion patterns and resolve identity ambiguities via heuristic fusion strategies. GSE models object dynamics using state-transition graphs derived from tracklet kinematics; each refinement step updates internal belief states via probabilistic trajectory merging under uncertainty constraints.

primitives.name: Tracking-by-Tracking Paradigm
primitives.verbatim_quote: We introduce a standardized paradigm termed Tracking-byTracking (TBT), which operates exclusively on arbitrary off-theshelf tracking outputs and produces offline-refined trajectories.
primitives.assumptions: The system assumes availability of arbitrary upstream tracking outputs without architectural dependency.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Failure occurs when upstream inputs lack sufficient spatial-temporal consistency.

layer2.mapping: TBT maps to GSI's probabilistic trajectory alignment and to GSE's state transition graph refinement.

primitives.name: Resource Unconstrained Optimization
primitives.verbatim_quote: Each module is deliberately designed to capitalize on the two fundamental properties of offline tracking: resource unconstrainedness, which permits global optimization beyond real-time limits, and future observability, which enables trajectory reasoning over the full temporal horizon.
primitives.assumptions: Computational resources are unlimited; full temporal sequence is accessible.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Performance degradation under memory or time constraints.

Offline-Poly addresses these by proposing a Tracking-by-Tracking (TBT) paradigm that decouples the tracker from specific upstream components. The TBT paradigm ensures strong generalization capability by operating on arbitrary tracking outputs, thus supporting diverse input modalities and detector architectures. reasoning_traces.think: Chapter 4 introduces Offline-Poly, a novel framework for offline 3D multi-object tracking that leverages both geometric and semantic priors. It builds upon prior work such as RethinkMOT and BiTrack, which require either training or upstream segmentation. Offline-Poly instead operates purely from existing tracking outputs, using a TBT (Temporal Bundle Tracking) framework. The method integrates structure (bounding boxes, maps) and semantics (feature maps, queries) to enhance tracking robustness. Key innovations include the Single Tracker Matching (STM) module for re-identifying fragmented tracks and the Multiple Tracker Matching (MTM) module for trajectory fusion. Ablation studies validate the contributions of each component. The framework demonstrates superior performance on nuScenes, especially in terms of HOTA, AMOTA, and MOTA metrics. This chapter establishes a foundational approach for offline 3D MOT that emphasizes modularity, learning-free operation, and adaptability to diverse sensor inputs.
